_real_world.class: IDECM: AN/ALQ-214(V)4/5 L3Harris On-Board Jammer + AN/ALR-67(V)3 Raytheon radar warning receiver
_real_world.variant_scope: F/A-18E/F Block II/III Super Hornet self-protection EW suite (RWR + internal deception jammer + towed decoy/chaff/flare countermeasures)
public_equipment: AN/ALQ-214(V)4/5 IDECM On-Board Jammer, MOSA-compliant (L3Harris, NAVAIR)

_provenance.modeling_note: Super Hornet's own self-protection suite, distinct from the EA-18G's offensive ALQ-99/NGJ-MB jamming pods (modeled separately as CSG_US_ALQ99_NGJ_MB). No public power_watts, precise bandwidth, or jamming effective_angle figures exist for either ALR-67 or ALQ-214 (classified self-protection parameters). rwr.sensitivity_dbm and countermeasures.* are proxy-copied unchanged from the repo's generic Generic_Gen4_EW baseline (aircraft/modules/ew_suites/gen4_standard.json), since no public RWR sensitivity or chaff/flare loadout figures exist either. jammer.bandwidth_mhz is derived from ALR-67's sourced 0.5-20 GHz detection span (19.5 GHz range, expressed here as the coverage span in MHz) as a proxy for the paired jammer's frequency coverage, since ALQ-214 is designed to respond across the same threat band the RWR detects; jammer.type is set to DeceptionDRFM (vs NoiseBarrage) because ALQ-214 is publicly described as a repeater/deception jammer (IDECM Onboard Jammer using digital RF memory techniques), which is the one qualitative, sourced distinction available among the engine's 3-value jammer.type enum.

rwr.sensitivity_dbm.note: proxy copied unchanged from repo Generic_Gen4_EW baseline; no public ALR-67 sensitivity figure

jammer.power_watts.note: proxy copied unchanged from repo Generic_Gen4_EW baseline; ALQ-214 output power is not publicly disclosed

jammer.bandwidth_mhz.note: derived from AN/ALR-67(V)3's sourced 0.5-20 GHz detection frequency range (Wikipedia): (20000-64)~=19936 MHz span, used as an engineering_estimate proxy for the paired jammer's frequency coverage since ALQ-214 responds across the same detected threat band; not a directly-published jammer bandwidth figure

jammer.type.note: L3Harris/NAVAIR describe ALQ-214 IDECM as an active onboard deception/repeater jammer (vs simple noise jamming); mapped to the DeceptionDRFM enum value as the closest qualitative match among the schema's 3-value jammer.type enum

jammer.effective_angle.note: proxy copied unchanged from repo Generic_Gen4_EW baseline; no public figure

jammer.is_active.note: false: default-off state, activated at runtime by mission logic, matching the repo Generic_Gen4_EW baseline convention

countermeasures.chaff_count.note: proxy copied unchanged from repo Generic_Gen4_EW baseline; no public per-sortie chaff loadout figure for the Super Hornet's ALE-47 dispenser

countermeasures.flare_count.note: proxy copied unchanged from repo Generic_Gen4_EW baseline; no public figure

countermeasures.release_interval.note: proxy copied unchanged from repo Generic_Gen4_EW baseline; no public figure

countermeasures.auto_mode.note: true: the ALE-47 dispenser supports programmed automatic release sequences; matches repo Generic_Gen4_EW baseline convention
